title: Shanghai
description: A French Concession hour: plane trees, a corner mansion, and a lane that still sells coffee like it invented it.
footnote: Walked late afternoon along Wukang and Anfu. Shade helps.

stops.title: Wukang Building
stops.description: The ship-shaped corner that everyone photographs. Stand across the street first.

stops.title: Postal Museum
stops.description: The old general post office on the creek. A pause for the building, not the stamps.

stops.title: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street
stops.description: Where the pedestrian street meets Middle Fujian Road. Stand at the crossing and let the crowd set the pace.

stops.title: Anfu Road
stops.description: Plane trees and shopfronts that reward walking the whole block instead of one café.

stops.title: Ferguson Lane
stops.description: A small courtyard off Wukang Road. Easy to miss if you only follow the mansion crowd.
